verses.1: And after that, David defeated the Philistines. He captured Gath and its daughters from the hands of the Philistines.
verses.2: And he made Moab his servants. So Moab became David’s servants, carrying offerings to him.
verses.3: And David defeated the king of Zobah, Hama. This happened as David walked towards the river Pherath to place his hand on it.
verses.4: David gathered an army of ten thousand chariots, seven thousand cavalry, and forty thousand infantrymen. David destroyed all those chariots. He kept only one hundred chariots for himself.
verses.5: And Abram Darmeshik went to Esau to meet with King Zobah. David had with him in the land of Abram twelve thousand men.
verses.6: And David settled in the land of Edom. Edom became a place where David had servants who brought him offerings. And Jehovah saved David from all his troubles.
verses.7: David took the golden crowns that belonged to the servants of Hadadzer. He brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.8: And from those cities, David took a great quantity of jewels. He made the sea of jewels, as well as all kinds of jewels.
verses.9: And Tso’u heard from King Hamath that David had defeated all the troops of King Zobah.
verses.10: And he sent his messengers to King David, asking him to bless and honor him for having defeated Hadadezer. For among all those who fought against Hadadezer, Hadadezer alone was killed. And all of his gold, silver, and treasures were taken as spoils.
verses.11: King David also sanctified them, along with the gold and silver that was brought from all the nations: from Adam, from Noah, from the sons of Ham, from the Philistines, and from Ammon.
verses.12: And Abshai son of Zuriyah struck Adam on the hill of Merkha. It was about ten thousand times that many.
verses.13: And Adam appointed rulers over all people. And every person became David’s servant. Thus, Jehovah saved David from all his troubles.
verses.14: And David ruled over all of Israel. He carried out justice and righteousness for every nation.
verses.15: And Joab, son of Zeruiah, will lead the army. And Yosafat, son of Ahilud, will be their judge.
verses.16: And Zadok, son of Achitub, and Abimelach, son of Aviatar were priests. Also, Shusha was the scribe.
verses.17: And Benjamin, son of Yehoyada, knew about my birth and my adoption. And the first sons of David were in the hands of the king.
